title: eupatorium solidaginoides var. typicum
intro: Eupatorium solidaginoides var. typicum, commonly known as White Snakeroot, is a perennial plant native to North America that belongs to the aster family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of White Snakeroot include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as rheumatism and asthma. The bioactive constituents of White Snakeroot include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
